column1: # Province id -> kanji / Chinese name map for 三國志II 覇王の大陸 (Namco, FC 1992).
# The ROM stores katakana only (name table: PRG bank $30 @ $9A1A, id*8; see
# tools/extract_province_data.py). The kanji below are the Han readings of those
# katakana, cross-checked against the printed manual map (docs/manual_kb/14-map.md)
# and against the ROM's starting ownership (record[0]) per ruler.
# zh_hant = traditional Chinese, zh_hans = simplified Chinese, pinyin = Mandarin.
# "note" records readings where the manual scan and the ROM katakana disagree.
